Is this your house, Freedos~?
Yeah, it's nothing fancy. I built it in a hurry.
I'll be studying the royal dragon cocoon here.\nIf you need anything, feel free to come and see\nme.
Alright, let's get down to business.\nThere's something I want you to find for me.
Of course! I'll work hard for gold and silver,\noopsie...I mean for everyone!
You can't just say oopsie and pretend you never\nsaid that...
We need a source of magic energy to help transfer\nall of the royal dragon cocoon's power to the ark.\nSomething that is inexhaustible and doesn't change
under any conditions. So I want you to\nhurry and find a special material called\n"Ancient Eternal Charcoal".
Hmm~, where can we get it?
Honestly, I have no idea...
What do you mean you have no idea...? But you're\nsure it's somewhere here in Opia Twinpalms, right?
I'm not sure about that either...
What~? You can't be serious~!
How are we supposed to find it then?!
If it turns out Ancient Eternal Charcoal doesn't\nexist, I'll have to consider the next best\nalternative.
But before I make that decision, I need you to\nprove that it can't be found here. So, make sure\nyou explore every corner of this place.
Do you even realize what you're saying is\nridiculous?
Ugh...the gold and silver reward is tempting, but\nthis is a really difficult task~.
Why don't you check out the terrain of\nOpia Twinpalms first? You might discover something\nalong the way.
I guess we have no choice but to head out and hope\nwe stumble upon it~.
Jeez, this is a real disaster...
Well, complaining about it here won't get us\nanywhere. Let's just start by checking out that\nmountain over there.
